summary: Winds throughout the eastern Gulf are now northeasterly, so any lingering rip risk along west-facing Gulf County beaches will fade quickly this afternoon. On Sunday night, northeast winds will increase quite a bit, bringing a high risk of rip currents to Franklin County beaches starting Monday. Elsewhere, a moderate rip current risk should prevail.
